# Summary and questions

This note is a summary of the adiabatic echo in the Rydberg system.

# The pertubated adiabatic analysis

Cinsider the time-dependent Hamiltonian
$$
H_\epsilon(t)=H_0(t)+\epsilon V, \qquad H_0(t)\equiv H_0(s(t)).
$$
The evolution unitary then takes the form $U_\epsilon(T,0)=U_0(T,0)U_I(T)$ with
$$
U_I(T)
=\mathcal T \exp\left[ -i\epsilon\int_0^Tdt\,V_I(t)\right].
$$
